# jans_admin_ui_policy_store (Resource)

Resource for managing AdminUI Cedarling policy stores.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the policy store.
- `displayname` (String) Human-readable name of the policy store.
- `inum` (String) Unique identifier of the policy store.
- `jans_status` (String) Status of the policy store. Possible values are active and inactive.
- `jans_usr_dn` (String) DN of the user that owns the policy store.
- `policy_store` (String) Base64-encoded .cjar policy store archive. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Creation date of the policy store.
- `dn` (String) DN of the policy store.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jans_last_upd` (String) Last update date of the policy store.
